svg.text: THE D.U.M.B. · THE PLAN ON THE SQUARES · 84 x 84 squares of 3.5 m
Every coloured square is floor, the colour and the number are its depth. Research is designed in full; the Ring, Level P3 and Command are block plans.

g.text: THE CONTROL ROOM (a step up, a window on the ring)
pit at level 3, the detector in it
THE HANGAR floor at level 5, 22 x 9 squares
black aircraft, the saucer, the workshop; the gallery snakes over it
lower deck: the bays, the freight lift
THE BIG BOARD (its walk at level 3)
level 6: it looks down on the board

svg.text: DEPTH (1 level = 1.75 m)
Level P3: the tram deck (14 m)
the Ring; the motor pool's lower deck
the Hangar's floor; the Range's gallery
the Dream Wing; the detector pit
the Labs, the White Rooms, Command's door
Sub-Level 7; the vats, Disposal
the shaft under the Vault Gantry
SIGNS
a number in a square = its level
stripes + arrow = a stair (the arrow points UP)
arrow, no stripes = a ramp (2 squares a level)
dashed inner square = a deck or bridge over the floor
red dashes = a LEDGE: drop down, no way back up
blue dots = the beam pipe (not walked)
dashes on dark = the tram track
yellow dot = a way out of the zone
DISTRICTS (the corner mark of each plot)
CERN, The Ring
Level P3
Sub-Level 7 (stays as built)
Research (the sample)
Command
